purpose: Classify every environment TileKind by the topology behavior it should use as Havenwild moves to LPC-authored terrain, caves, interiors, paths, and modular structures.

semantic_boundary_replacement.description: Neighboring material relationships. These use owner/neighbor LPC replacement roles. A cell must draw one complete replacement role at a time unless an authored mixed-role family exists.

same_family_assembly.description: Tileable structures that assemble against their own family: roads, paths, bridges, caves, floors, walls, cliffs, and modular building shells.

derived_overlay_or_state.description: Generated from neighboring terrain, farm state, or simulation state; these should not be primary paint buttons in the production terrain palette.

non_tileable_object_or_stamp.description: Vegetation dressing and props belong to object/stamp placement rather than terrain autotile cells.

promotionPlan: Promote roads and paths next using authored same-family LPC/Wang roles.
Then promote cave floor/wall, interior floors/walls, cliffs, bridges, and modular building exteriors.
Only add mixed edge+diagonal visual roles after the source family has authored cells for that exact topology.
